mapper.sql: select p.post_id, p.post_title, p.category_id, p.user_id, p.like_count, p.favorite_count, p.comment_count, p.status, p.is_featured, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, p.audit_remark, (select c.category_name from learning_category c where c.category_id = p.category_id and c.del_flag = '0') as category_name, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = p.user_id) as user_name from learning_post p

select p.post_id, p.post_title, p.category_id, p.user_id, p.content, p.like_count, p.favorite_count, p.comment_count, p.status, p.is_featured, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, p.audit_remark, (select c.category_name from learning_category c where c.category_id = p.category_id and c.del_flag = '0') as category_name, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = p.user_id) as user_name from learning_post p
mapper.insert: insert into learning_post( post_title, category_id, user_id, content, status, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{postTitle}, #{categoryId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update learning_post
post_title = #{postTitle},
category_id = #{categoryId,jdbcType=BIGINT},
content = #{content}, status = #{status},
is_featured = #{isFeatured}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where post_id = #{postId} and del_flag = '0'

update learning_post
status = #{status}, is_featured = #{isFeatured}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_by = #{updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_time = sysdate()
where post_id = #{postId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '3'
